**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding Meridian Fieldworks. Targeted searches for "solicit", "induce", "hire", "employ", and "recruit" surfaced no restrictive covenant of that kind anywhere in the document. Instead, § 12.3 works in our favour: it expressly preserves our freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and has Copperleaf acknowledge that we have made no no-hire (or exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, or minimum-volume) commitment.

That is the playbook's preferred position — no non-solicit on the Customer — so the clause is compliant and should be left as drafted.
